hints.title: Greedy Course Scheduling Invariant
hints.text: When considering courses ordered by deadline, taking shorter courses preserves more future capacity than longer courses.

hints.title: Deadline Sorting Order
hints.text: Sort all courses in ascending order of their end deadlines so each course is evaluated before its expiration.

hints.title: Max-Heap Swapping of Longest Courses
hints.text: Iterate through sorted courses. Add current duration to total_time and push duration to a max-heap. If total_time exceeds the course deadline, pop the longest duration from the heap and subtract it from total_time.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Sorting by deadline and maintaining a max-heap of taken course durations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy selection based solely on duration or deadline alone fails counterexamples.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Max-heap prioritizes eviction of the longest taken course in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort by deadline and greedily swap out the maximum duration course when deadline is exceeded.
